slides.name: 04-paper-fixes
slides.crumb: four habits / in the order they pay off
slides.headline:
FOUR HABITS.
HALF THE BILL.
slides.margin: None of these make it dumber. They just stop it re-reading your whole day.

items.s: Switch the huge memory on per job, never by default.
Open the project you work in, not your whole computer.
A summary still drags the old topic along. Start clean.
Answers against re-reading. Once a month is enough.
